title: Grantha Part Schema
description: Schema for a single content part of a multi-part edition. Contains content arrays and identifiers. Versioned using semantic versioning.

kind.description: Explicit file-type discriminator. Must be 'grantha-part' for edition part files.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema in semver format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Major version changes indicate breaking schema changes.

edition_id.description: The ID of the edition this part belongs to.

grantha_id.description: The ID of the parent grantha. Optional; derivable from the edition_id in most cases.

part_num.description: The sequential number of this part within the edition.

commentary.description: Exactly one commentary per edition part. Absent if this is a mūla-only edition. Mutually exclusive with `commentaries`: emit `commentary` when exactly one commentary, `commentaries` when two or more.

commentaries.description: Two or more commentaries for one edition part (e.g. a bhāṣya plus a subcommentary carrying parent_commentary_id). Mutually exclusive with the singular `commentary`.
